outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram illustrating the experimental pipeline; it is not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B shows fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field images (micrograph/photograph), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart of lactate concentration with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group (Normal lung, LUAD, LUSC).
Panel D is a bar chart of lactate concentration with individual data points (dots) overlaid for High pH and Low pH groups.
Panel E is a schematic model illustrating the immunosuppressive niche, not a data plot.
